# E0421: a view can't be stored

A view reads a value that someone else holds, so it can't be stored where it could outlive it. Store the value, or the range it covers.

- Rule: [`views.view-types`](../../reference/13-modes.md#views.view-types)
- Reported at: the view type where it is written in a field, a payload, an element, a component or a type argument of a declared type, or the expression that builds such a value from a view.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0421:3
use std.view

type Line = { text: view.View<str> }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Line = { text: str }
```

## What the compiler prints

```text
  3 │ type Line = { text: view.View<str> }
    │                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A view reads a value that someone else holds, so it can't be stored where it
could outlive it. Store the value, or the range it covers.
```
